newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber higher on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber higher on short covering.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade March SIR20 offer prices were higher in late trading on Thursday on the back of short covering by dealers and tight supply, traders said.
The said March SIR20 was higher at 53.75-54.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and Surabaya while levels went up at 53.50-53.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang.
Offer prices were quoted at 53.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Padang and at 53.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi. "Offer prices go up because of short-covering," said one trader.
Traders said market sentiment improved because of tight supply and foreign buying from Europe and the United States.
Traders said prices were up because buyers had started to cover their stocks again after taking a wait-and-see position in the past few weeks on the hope that prices would continue to decline.
"Buyers thought that prices would continue to go down because of the ample supply. But they were wrong because we are now actually experiencing tight supply," said one trader.
Traders said after prices fell in the past few weeks farmers became reluctant to tap their rubber trees, which led to a shortage in raw material.
